name: zigbeeInstallCodeExtension
description: Device extension schema for provisioning a Zigbee device with an installation code.

attributes.name: installCode
attributes.description: The Zigbee installation code, including its 16-bit CRC in least-significant-byte-first order. The value is Base64 encoded in the SCIM JSON representation. Valid decoded lengths are 8, 10, 14, or 18 octets, comprising a 6-, 8-, 12-, or 16-octet installation code followed by a 2-octet CRC. Zigbee 3.0 uses the 18-octet form.
